```{python}
#| label: fig-verification-tb
#| echo: false
#| fig-cap: "Architecture of a self-checking testbench. The generator creates transactions, and the driver turns each one into pin values at the inputs of the design under test (DUT). The monitor observes the pins at the inputs and outputs and turns them back into transactions. The reference model computes what the DUT must do, the scoreboard compares it with what the DUT did, and the coverage collector counts which situations the stimulus has reached."
#| fig-alt: "Block diagram. In the top row, a generator box feeds a driver box with transactions, and the driver feeds the DUT box with pin values. Below the DUT is a monitor box. It receives the DUT outputs from above and the input pin values through a tap on the line between driver and DUT. The monitor feeds a coverage box on its right, a scoreboard box below it with the actual outputs, and a reference model box on the lower left with the inputs. The reference model feeds the scoreboard with the expected outputs, and the scoreboard produces pass or fail."
import schemdraw as sd
from schemdraw import flow
from schemdraw import elements as elm
sd.svgconfig.svg2 = False

BLUE, BLUE_L = '#6c8ebf', '#dae8fc'     # design
YEL, YEL_L = '#d6b656', '#fff2cc'       # testbench
GREY, GREY_L = '#666666', '#f5f5f5'     # results

H = 1.1
xg, xd, xu, xc = 0.0, 4.7, 9.1, 13.5
yt, ym, yb = 2.2, 0.0, -2.2


def box(x, y, text, fill, edge, w=2.6):
    return flow.Box(w=w, h=H).at((x, y)).anchor('center').fill(fill).color(edge).label(text, color='black')


with sd.Drawing(canvas='svg') as d:
    d.config(unit=1, fontsize=11, lw=1.5, bgcolor='white')

    gen = box(xg, yt, 'generator\n(directed, random)', YEL_L, YEL, w=3.2)
    drv = box(xd, yt, 'driver', YEL_L, YEL)
    dut = box(xu, yt, 'DUT', BLUE_L, BLUE)
    mon = box(xu, ym, 'monitor', YEL_L, YEL)
    cov = box(xc, ym, 'coverage', YEL_L, YEL)
    ref = box(xd, yb, 'reference model', YEL_L, YEL, w=3.0)
    sb = box(xu, yb, 'scoreboard', YEL_L, YEL)
    res = box(xc, yb, 'pass / fail', GREY_L, GREY)

    flow.Arrow().at(gen.E).to(drv.W)
    elm.Label().at(((xg + 1.6 + xd - 1.3)/2, yt + 0.25)).label('transactions', fontsize=10)
    flow.Arrow().at(drv.E).to(dut.W)
    elm.Label().at(((xd + 1.3 + xu - 1.3)/2 + 0.1, yt + 0.25)).label('pin values', fontsize=10)

    # the monitor observes the inputs (tap) and the outputs of the DUT
    xt = (xd + xu)/2 - 0.45
    elm.Dot(radius=0.06).at((xt, yt))
    flow.Line().at((xt, yt)).to((xt, ym))
    flow.Arrow().at((xt, ym)).to(mon.W)
    elm.Label().at((xt - 0.2, (yt + ym)/2)).label('inputs', halign='right', fontsize=10)
    flow.Arrow().at(dut.S).to(mon.N)
    elm.Label().at((xu + 0.15, (yt + ym)/2)).label('outputs', halign='left', fontsize=10)

    # the monitor feeds the coverage, the scoreboard, and the model
    flow.Arrow().at(mon.E).to(cov.W)
    flow.Arrow().at(mon.S).to(sb.N)
    elm.Label().at((xu + 0.15, (ym + yb)/2)).label('actual', halign='left', fontsize=10)
    xi = xu - 0.8
    flow.Line().at((xi, ym - H/2)).to((xi, (ym + yb)/2))
    flow.Line().at((xi, (ym + yb)/2)).to((xd, (ym + yb)/2))
    flow.Arrow().at((xd, (ym + yb)/2)).to(ref.N)
    elm.Label().at((xd - 0.15, (ym + yb)/2 + 0.25)).label('inputs', halign='right', fontsize=10)
    flow.Arrow().at(ref.E).to(sb.W)
    elm.Label().at(((xd + 1.5 + xu - 1.3)/2, yb + 0.25)).label('expected', fontsize=10)
    flow.Arrow().at(sb.E).to(res.W)
```
